common_compatibility.change: Only parse_topo_affinity maps allocated physical rows through existing info-m logical mapping. Unknown/unallocated rows are skipped; invalid, conflicting and multichip mappings reject.
common_compatibility.unchanged: Original official tree, all other copied source bytes and prebuilt ABI libraries; CPU assignment, migration and IRQ algorithms are unchanged.
common_compatibility.installed_runtime_resource_policy: Copy every installed package file except Python caches, including _build_info.py, all original _cann_ops_custom metadata/kernel binaries and internal relative runtime links; verify original/copied inventory, target identity and bytes. No rebuild or CANN/SDK replacement.
common_compatibility.previous_prepare_draft: Helper469 was rejected before any91 execution after81 zero-generation initialization found omitted CANN runtime assets. Final helperfe00 preserves the installed assets; CPU patchedb7 bytes are unchanged. No91 model used the incomplete copy.
common_compatibility.attribution: A common foundation compatibility fix, not a PegaFlow MOD gain.
pre_generation_requirements: Independently run the guarded prepare script on restored91 and verify every copied source/library byte; no upstream mutation.
Fresh actual SDK import must resolve cpu_binding.py to the isolated copied tree with the declared patched SHA.
Actual per-worker/per-thread affinities and warnings must be inspected; a True flag alone does not demonstrate effective binding.
common_compatibility.reuse_policy: Read-only reuse fe00/b7 complete Ascend carrier with full origin/copy inventory/byte/link/ABI checks. Stock vLLM path is separate and must resolve original schedulerSHA9ae149, never Bid ae127.
common_compatibility.host_actual_prepare_status: Prior81 common carrier byte identity known; newPega81 SDK/source/ABI/CPU/effectivebinding/token/C8 admission not yet executed.
